system.description: When an Attack would drop you to 0% Health Bar, roll an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, drop to 10% instead.

upgrades.description: The crawler's Health Bar is unaffected by damage that would drop them to 0%.
Cooldown is twice per scene. When it triggers, the crawler heals to 100% and has +Rank DR until the end of the next round of combat.

system.limitations: This Limited Skill can only be learned via a Race, Class, or item. Mark the skill for advancement until you reach Rank 5. After that, Ranks in this Skill only increase by magical means and training.
